result.summary: Updates `doc/i2p.md` to document the minimum compatible versions of Java I2P (≥ 2.10.0) and i2pd (≥ 2.58.0). It adjusts the Compatibility section, which previously claimed any SAM v3.1 router could be used.
result.problem: Documentation currently misinforms users that any SAM v3.1 router works with Bitcoin Core, even though PR #35696 introduced a dependency on leaseSet encryption types (`i2cp.leaseSetEncType=6,4`) that older routers do not support.
evidence: PR description: "In `doc/i2p.md`, the Compatibility section stated that any SAM v3.1 router can be used. Bitcoin Core now relies on a feature that requires recent routers: `i2cp.leaseSetEncType=6,4` (introduced in #35696). This is supported by Java I2P ≥ 2.10.0 and i2pd ≥ 2.58.0."
result.card: This pull request updates doc/i2p.md to document the minimum supported versions of Java I2P (≥ 2.10.0) and i2pd (≥ 2.58.0). Documentation previously claimed any SAM v3.1 router was compatible, but PR #35696 introduced leaseSet encryption settings that fail on older routers. This prevents I2P users from running into silent connectivity failures caused by outdated router software.

risk.why: It only updates documentation text for I2P router compatibility requirements.
